judgments.accuracy: Original used several inflated or mismatched claims. The revised article confines judgments to particular documents, distinguishes legal holdings from narrative jokes, and states scientific limits.
judgments.substance: Rebuilt all five cases around actual commercial terms and close readings. Added Landmark minimum annual subscription calculation, KCM qualifications and failure explanation, publisher optional-instruction policy, FTC scope/revenue limitations, TM refund requirements and updated 2025 clinical guidance.
judgments.length: Cut cases that did not earn their space: founder scandals, jet anecdotes, net-worth estimates, Oprah sales claims, The Secret digression, Beatles history and empire catalog. Final substantive article is 2344 words versus 4096 under the same method.
judgments.voice: Removed repeated strongest-defense/tell pair boxes, imagined seminar scenes, universal free-versus-paid assertions, cash-register/table slogans, endless-ladder repetition and invented dot ratings. Each case now proceeds through evidence and its specific limitation.
judgments.original_contribution: Primary-document comparison: current Landmark annual minimum calculation; court treatment of publishers' contradictory sharing accounts; close reading of KCM expected-return qualifications versus absent-return advice; study comparator inspection. Not a claim of private reporting or attendance.

factual_corrections.before: Landmark approximately $700 and only three-day ballroom format.
factual_corrections.after: Current American landing page advertised $1177 standard, $2277 Signature with distinct online format. Dates and page-specific status explicit.

factual_corrections.before: Stoicism with a clipboard; founder family, tax and abuse biography; legally not a cult.
factual_corrections.after: Removed unsourced comparison, irrelevant allegations and nonexistent legal-status formulation. Focused on documented purchasing terms.

factual_corrections.before: All good classes must end; any continuing ladder shows exploitation.
factual_corrections.after: Continuing instruction and paid work can be legitimate. Pressure needs separate evidence; published catalog alone does not establish it.

factual_corrections.before: ACIM copyright link to 262 F. Supp. 2d 251 was presented as the final holding; court ruled Jesus could not copyright.
factual_corrections.after: Correct October 24, 2003 opinion at 288 F. Supp. 2d 544 and ensuing specific judgment. Divine-authorship defense had already been dismissed; the successful issue was general authorized prepublication distribution without notice under applicable historical law.

factual_corrections.before: Entire Course handed into public domain; Schucman almost never earned money and never wanted to.
factual_corrections.after: Specific registration A693944 voided; no blanket statement about later editions/translations. Removed unsupported claims about earnings/desires; actual opinion says proceeds were paid to Schucman and later her husband.

factual_corrections.before: All prosperity theology equals giving money to get rich, with donation identical to belief.
factual_corrections.after: Named KCM examples; preserved explicit qualification that a seed alone does not itself cause healing and that hundredfold is not literal times 100. Critique concerns advice following failed return, not every church or deceptive intent.

factual_corrections.before: Copeland 2014 demons interview and uncertain net worth, Creflo $65m arithmetic, Oral Roberts anecdote, Senate no findings.
factual_corrections.after: Removed entire noncentral jet/anecdote chain rather than reproducing or trying to infer corrected claims. No claim these were all verified.

factual_corrections.before: Industry-wide 99 percent losses and 95 percent quitting; all MLM rewards need losers.
factual_corrections.after: FTC 70 disclosures, 2023 review/2024 publication, company payments and omitted expenses. Disclosed retail income limitation; no industry-wide precise loss estimate. Legal MLM versus illegal pyramid scheme distinction.

factual_corrections.before: Goop evidence was secondary reporting and conflated with MLM.
factual_corrections.after: Primary Napa County DA announcement, $145000 civil settlement, allegations/injunction/refunds. Goop direct retail separated from MLM incentive structure.

factual_corrections.before: TM $980 is simply buying a secret mantra; unverified mantra tables.
factual_corrections.after: Current standard fee plus reduced rates/scholarships and services/conditional guarantee. Unverified mantra-selection claims removed.

factual_corrections.before: AHA uniquely mentions TM; all health benefits settled.
factual_corrections.after: 2025 AHA/ACC modest blood-pressure adjunct recommendation with short-trial limits; no unique-medical-endorsement inference.

factual_corrections.before: Yogic Flying described as selling levitation; Maharishi Effect never independently replicated.
factual_corrections.after: Organizational hopping/hovering/flying descriptions attributed. Never-replicated assertion removed; original crime study modeled counterfactual explained and critique labeled my inference.

uncertainties: Current company policies and prices can change; article dates the advertised Landmark page and links live TM terms.
Official terms do not measure actual pressure frequency, customer outcomes or every refusal/complaint. The article explicitly ends on that limit.

KCM critique is a reading of its public articles, not a finding of intent or individual donor harm.
No full systematic replication audit of Maharishi Effect literature was performed. The post does not assert that no independent replication exists.
